config.title: Party frames
config.about: Raid-style frames for your allies: health, mana, shields and potions at a glance.

settings.title: Bar size
settings.about: Tall blocks or slim bars, each with the potion count beside them.

settings.title: Shield style
settings.about: How an ally's shield is drawn at the end of their health.

settings.title: Show level
settings.about: Each ally's level beside their name. The bars grow to fit.

settings.title: Show class
settings.about: Each ally's class beside their name. The bars grow to fit.
